title: Operations Director, Curriculum & School Support
text:
**About K12 Coalition**

K12 Coalition provides products and services that help K-12 schools and teachers achieve transformational learning outcomes. We tackle many of today’s toughest education obstacles, including teacher certification, test preparation, professional learning, curriculum, consulting, and strategic planning. K12 Coalition came together when educators with deep experience as teachers, school leaders, and high-level district administrators observed a genuine need for something better. Our divisions include iteach, Passage Preparation, Professional Development Institute, Teaching Channel, Lavinia Group, and Keys to Literacy.

 

**About Lavinia Group**

Lavinia Group is dedicated to driving meaningful academic improvements in K-12 education through instructional coaching, professional learning, high-quality curriculum, strategic planning, and summer school support that enhances educator effectiveness and strengthens student outcomes.

 

With deep expertise in school leadership, curriculum implementation, and instructional best practices, Lavinia Group delivers tailored, research-based solutions to meet the evolving needs of our partners. Guided by a commitment to equity, instructional excellence, and long-term capacity building, we work alongside educators and district leaders through hands-on coaching, immersive training, and collaborative partnerships. Our mission is to help schools achieve transformational learning outcomes that endure beyond our direct support.

 

**Employment Type:**

* Full-Time
* Exempt
* Salaried

 

**Location:** Remote, available from anywhere within the U.S.

 

**The Opportunity**

Lavinia Group, a division of K12 Coalition, is seeking an Operations Director, Curriculum & School Support to build and lead the systems that bring our curriculum and professional learning services to schools. The largest focus of this role is managing the full operational lifecycle of our print curriculum, from demand forecasting and inventory planning to production, fulfillment, and direct customer support. This role also leads operational planning for digital curriculum, professional learning, and consultant staffing outside of our RISE summer learning program.

 

This is an opportunity to help shape how a newly structured operations team works together. Partnering with the Managing Director, Operations and fellow operations leaders, you will help establish clear responsibilities, shared processes, and scalable systems across Lavinia Group while leading execution within your own portfolio. You will turn product and service priorities into practical plans, use technology and AI to improve workflows, and build the operational foundation for new offerings and continued growth.

 

The Operations Director, Curriculum & School Support reports to the Managing Director, Operations and directly manages a Senior Associate, Operations. This role is ideal for an operations leader who enjoys building structure, solving complex delivery challenges, and staying closely involved in day-to-day execution.

 

**What You’ll Do**

Print Curriculum & Fulfillment Operations

* Lead the full print curriculum workflow, including demand forecasting, inventory planning, production schedules, ordering, and fulfillment.
* Partner with Sales and Curriculum teams to translate sales projections, partner needs, and product timelines into purchasing and production plans.
* Manage print vendors, book vendors, and fulfillment partners, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and issue resolution against quality, cost, and delivery expectations.
* Monitor inventory and fulfillment costs, anticipating shortages, excess stock, and delivery risks and adjusting plans as needs change.
* Provide direct customer support for curriculum orders and delivery questions, coordinating timely resolution of fulfillment issues and keeping partners informed.

Operational Systems & Product Implementation

* Build and improve the systems, workflows, and project plans that support curriculum and professional learning development, implementation, and delivery.
* Partner with Curriculum, Product, and Technology teams to define operational requirements for digital curriculum platforms and coordinate improvements that support users and internal teams.
* Establish consistent partner onboarding processes and coordinate operational readiness for product launches, updates, and retirements.
* Use technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to reduce manual work, improve visibility, and create more reliable, scalable workflows.
* Partner with fellow operations leaders to establish shared practices, clarify team handoffs, and resolve dependencies across Lavinia Group.

Professional Learning & Consultant Staffing

* Lead operational planning for partner-facing professional learning and coaching services, aligning schedules, staffing, resources, and delivery requirements.
* Develop and maintain staffing and capacity plans, partnering with academic and service leaders to forecast facilitator, consultant, and content-development needs.
* Manage consultant staffing and utilization in Hub Planner, maintaining accurate assignments and availability and addressing capacity gaps with relevant leaders.
* Manage workflows for custom professional learning requests, pricing, and approvals in partnership with academic and business leaders.
* Establish operational delivery standards and monitor utilization, delivery days, and partner feedback to identify and implement improvements.

Budget & Performance Management

* Build and manage curriculum, product, and professional learning operating budgets in partnership with the Managing Director, Operations and relevant business leaders.
* Monitor spending, delivery costs, and budget performance, recommending adjustments that align resources with demand and organizational priorities.
* Maintain reporting that gives leaders clear visibility into inventory, fulfillment, staffing capacity, and operational performance.
* Coordinate with finance and sales operations colleagues to ensure accurate information and clear handoffs for invoicing, contracting, and vendor onboarding.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop the Senior Associate, Operations, setting clear priorities, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Provide ongoing coaching and feedback, delegate work effectively, and support professional growth while maintaining accountability for team deliverables.

Other Duties

* Support the team with additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to help meet evolving organizational goals and objectives.

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in operations, product operations, supply chain, or a related field, including managing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Direct experience managing operations for physical products sold to customers, including demand forecasting, inventory planning, production or purchasing coordination, and fulfillment.
* Experience managing vendors and fulfillment partners, including monitoring costs, quality, and delivery performance and resolving customer issues.
* Demonstrated success building scalable operational systems and workflows, including defining operational requirements, partnering across teams to implement improvements, and using AI-enabled tools and automation to reduce manual work.
* Experience managing budgets, analyzing operational data, and developing staffing, capacity, or resource plans.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports, including setting priorities, delegating work, and providing performance feedback.
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, for forecasting, reporting, data analysis, and operational decision-making, along with experience using project management or workflow tools.
* Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing priorities, and follow through on commitments.
* Experience in K–12 education, curriculum publishing, or professional learning is preferred but not required.

**How We Work at K12 Coalition**

Our work is grounded in five Core Competencies that guide how we collaborate, support others, and move work forward: Accountability, Adaptability, Collaboration, Customer Service Orientation, and Initiative.

* **Accountability:** Following through on work, owning commitments, and communicating progress or challenges along the way.
* **Adaptability:** Navigating change with flexibility and focus as priorities, information, or needs shift.
* **Collaboration:** Working together across roles and perspectives to achieve shared goals.
* **Customer Service Orientation:** Meeting the needs of internal and external partners with clarity, responsiveness, and follow-through.
* **Initiative:** Taking action without waiting to be asked and looking for ways to improve systems, processes, or experiences.

 

**Compensation Philosophy**

As part of our commitment to maintaining fair and consistent compensation practices, new hires are typically brought into the organization at a salary between the band minimum and midpoint, based on their qualifications, location, internal alignment, and the budgeted amount for the role.

 

**Why Work with Us**

We believe in supporting the whole employee by offering a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet diverse needs. Our full-time employee benefits include flexible time off, paid parental leave, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a 401(k) with company matching. We are committed to fostering a work environment that promotes both personal and professional well-being.

 

**Our Typical Selection Process**

Our selection process typically includes an online application, a short phone interview, a hiring manager interview, a candidate exercise, and a final interview.

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

K12 Coalition is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need assistance or accommodation during the interview process due to a disability, please email us at recruitingteam@k12coalition.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.

 

**Protecting Your Job Search**

K12 Coalition is committed to a transparent and secure recruitment process. Please keep the following in mind as you explore opportunities with us:

* **Official communication:** All recruitment-related communication will come from an @k12coalition.com email address. We do not use messaging platforms for recruiting.
* **Application process:** We do not send unsolicited job offers. All open positions are listed on our official Careers Page, and any offer follows a formal interview process.
* **No upfront payments:** We will never ask candidates to pay fees of any kind during the hiring process, including for training materials, background checks, or equipment.

 

If you receive any communication that does not align with the above, please report it to recruitingteam@k12coalition.com.
